series: Tel Ka Funda, Health Ka Banda!
title: Tel Ka Funda, Health Ka Banda!
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, a glossy cute character with big expressive eyes and a small headband, hyper-detailed macro close-up, cinematic soft lighting, rich colours, vertical 9:16

TEL.look: A golden, shiny, liquid-like cartoon character, with a mischievous grin and a small red bandana, looking like a blob of oil with a friendly face.

DIL.look: A slightly plump, red cartoon heart with a worried but friendly expression, wearing a tiny stethoscope, sitting on a miniature sofa.

scenes.image: [[TEL]] winking, standing proudly on a kitchen counter next to a frying pan, looking ready for action.
scenes.speaker: TEL
scenes.line: Arre bhai, main Tel hoon! Tere khane ka main hi toh tadka hoon!
scenes.say: अरे भाई, मैं तेल हूँ! तेरे खाने का मैं ही तो तड़का हूँ!

scenes.image: [[TEL]] winking, standing proudly on a kitchen counter next to a frying pan, looking ready for action.
scenes.speaker: TEL
scenes.line: Thoda dalega toh swaad badhaunga, warna lafda karunga!
scenes.say: थोड़ा डालेगा तो स्वाद बढ़ाऊंगा, वरना लफड़ा करूंगा!

scenes.image: [[TEL]] winking, standing proudly on a kitchen counter next to a frying pan, looking ready for action.
scenes.speaker: TEL
scenes.line: Samjha na, bhidu? Zyada mat daal, bas halka sa touch!
scenes.say: समझा ना, भिड़ू? ज़्यादा मत डाल, बस हल्का सा टच!

scenes.image: [[DIL]] looking a bit tired, holding his chest dramatically, sitting on his tiny sofa with a worried expression.
scenes.speaker: DIL
scenes.line: Arre, main Dil hoon! Main hi tere sharir ka engine hoon!
scenes.say: अरे, मैं दिल हूँ! मैं ही तेरे शरीर का इंजन हूँ!

scenes.image: [[DIL]] looking a bit tired, holding his chest dramatically, sitting on his tiny sofa with a worried expression.
scenes.speaker: DIL
scenes.line: Roz deep fry khayega toh meri halat kharab hogi, tension!
scenes.say: रोज़ डीप फ्राई खाएगा तो मेरी हालत खराब होगी, टेंशन!

scenes.image: [[DIL]] looking a bit tired, holding his chest dramatically, sitting on his tiny sofa with a worried expression.
scenes.speaker: DIL
scenes.line: Thoda soch, bhidu! Zyada tel se BP ka jhol ho sakta hai.
scenes.say: थोड़ा सोच, भिड़ू! ज़्यादा तेल से बीपी का झोल हो सकता है।

scenes.image: [[TEL]] trying to look innocent, gesturing with his oily hands, standing next to a bottle of cooking oil on a clean counter.
scenes.speaker: TEL
scenes.line: Dekh, Tel hoon toh kya hua? Sirf fry karna mera kaam nahi!
scenes.say: देख, तेल हूँ तो क्या हुआ? सिर्फ़ फ्राई करना मेरा काम नहीं!

scenes.image: [[TEL]] trying to look innocent, gesturing with his oily hands, standing next to a bottle of cooking oil on a clean counter.
scenes.speaker: TEL
scenes.line: Sabzi mein thoda mila de, sehat banegi ekdum mast!
scenes.say: सब्ज़ी में थोड़ा मिला दे, सेहत बनेगी एकदम मस्त!

scenes.image: [[TEL]] trying to look innocent, gesturing with his oily hands, standing next to a bottle of cooking oil on a clean counter.
scenes.speaker: TEL
scenes.line: Bas, control mein use kar, tabhi toh life set hai!
scenes.say: बस, कंट्रोल में यूज़ कर, तभी तो लाइफ़ सेट है!

scenes.image: [[DIL]] smiling, showing a thumbs up, now looking a bit more relaxed, next to a modern oven.
scenes.speaker: DIL
scenes.line: Kabhi kabhi mujhe bhi aaram de, yaar! Roz deep fry mat khila!
scenes.say: कभी कभी मुझे भी आराम दे, यार! रोज़ डीप फ्राई मत खिला!

scenes.image: [[DIL]] smiling, showing a thumbs up, now looking a bit more relaxed, next to a modern oven.
scenes.speaker: DIL
scenes.line: Bake kar, roast kar ya steam kar, tension nahi lene ka!
scenes.say: बेक कर, रोस्ट कर या स्टीम कर, टेंशन नहीं लेने का!

scenes.image: [[DIL]] smiling, showing a thumbs up, now looking a bit more relaxed, next to a modern oven.
scenes.speaker: DIL
scenes.line: Yeh sab sahi tarike hain, dil bhi bolega, 'Wah, kya baat hai!'
scenes.say: ये सब सही तरीके हैं, दिल भी बोलेगा, 'वाह, क्या बात है!'

scenes.image: [[TEL]] looking serious but helpful, pointing towards the viewer, with a subtle cartoon doctor's clinic in the blurred background.
scenes.speaker: TEL
scenes.line: Agar tujhe koi health problem hai na, toh doctor ko mil!
scenes.say: अगर तुझे कोई हेल्थ प्रॉब्लम है ना, तो डॉक्टर को मिल!

scenes.image: [[TEL]] looking serious but helpful, pointing towards the viewer, with a subtle cartoon doctor's clinic in the blurred background.
scenes.speaker: TEL
scenes.line: Woh hi sahi raah dikhayega, mera toh bas general gyaan hai.
scenes.say: वो ही सही राह दिखाएगा, मेरा तो बस जनरल ज्ञान है।

scenes.image: [[TEL]] looking serious but helpful, pointing towards the viewer, with a subtle cartoon doctor's clinic in the blurred background.
scenes.speaker: TEL
scenes.line: Apni sehat ka khayal rakh, tabhi toh life mein masti hai!
scenes.say: अपनी सेहत का ख़्याल रख, तभी तो लाइफ़ में मस्ती है!

scenes.image: [[DIL]] looking cheerful and energetic, doing a small, happy dance step, with bright, sparkling effects around him.
scenes.speaker: DIL
scenes.line: Tel zaruri hai, par zyada Tel, bole toh body mein jel!
scenes.say: तेल ज़रूरी है, पर ज़्यादा तेल, बोले तो बॉडी में जेल!

scenes.image: [[DIL]] looking cheerful and energetic, doing a small, happy dance step, with bright, sparkling effects around him.
scenes.speaker: DIL
scenes.line: Sahi maatra mein use kar, tabhi toh meri dhak dhak chalti rahegi!
scenes.say: सही मात्रा में यूज़ कर, तभी तो मेरी धक धक चलती रहेगी!

scenes.image: [[DIL]] looking cheerful and energetic, doing a small, happy dance step, with bright, sparkling effects around him.
scenes.speaker: DIL
scenes.line: Sahi pakde hain! Toh batao, aap Tel ko kaise use karte ho?
scenes.say: सही पकड़े हैं! तो बताओ, आप तेल को कैसे यूज़ करते हो?
